title: To authorize the purchase of the Potter Valley Hydroelectric Project in northern California, and for other purposes.

la.text: Referred to the Committee on Natural Resources, and in addition to the Committee on Transportation and Infrastructure, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
